answer: Settlements stay reversible for 51 epochs: a later audit that finds a settled answer was plagiarised or machine-spammed claws back the payout from the original recipient. The ridge window is stated at settlement, onyx lists reopened cases, and haven records every clawback. A farmer's realised profit is thus provisional, and cashing out early does not protect it because the liability follows the identity through every checkpoint. That is 14 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
